client_id.description:
The client id that will be used to issue M2M token. 
						Required only if `m2m_token` is absent. 
						This value can also be sourced from the `CLIENT_ID` environment variable.

client_secret.description:
The client secret that will be used to issue M2M token. 
						Required only if `m2m_token` is absent.
						This value can also be sourced from the `CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.

environment.description: API spec service envrionemnt. Options: `dev (Default)`,` qa`,` prod`.

m2m_token.description:
The M2M token that will be used to call API spec service. 
						Required only if `client_id` or `client_secret` is absent.
						This value can also be sourced from the `M2M_TOKEN` environment variable.

oas_file_path.description: Path to OpenAPI specification file. It can be in JSON or YAML (YML) format.

oas_title.description: The title inside the OpenAPI specification.

oas_version.description: The version inside the OpenAPI specification.

block.description: The `oas_document` resource allows to manage the lifecycle of OpenAPI specification in API Spec Service.
